page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance configured with 16 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-RAM ratio. Built on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor, processing is supplied by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with 8 physical cores and 2 threads per core under a dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware features include 35 MB of L3 cache and instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI. The instance operates with a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, has no bundled local storage, and includes no GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark results highlight solid performance across multi-core and memory subsystems alongside modest single-core throughput. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 13055.33 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6324.0, supported by 75.86 GB/sec read and 55.65 GB/sec write memory bandwidth during uncached 256 MB block transfers. In real-world simulation tests, it delivers 11.35 million operations per second on Redis SET workloads and 9.98 GB/sec in static web serving. Conversely, single-thread performance is relatively limited, reflected in a Geekbench single-core score of 1001.0 and a single-core stress-ng rating in the lower quartile.

Resource allocation on this instance balances processing capacity and memory footprint, delivering reliable operational efficiency for scalable multi-threaded workloads. Because local storage is absent, all persistence depends on network-attached storage volumes, which introduces considerations for disk I/O performance over the 3 Gbps baseline network pipe. The system is well suited for general enterprise application hosting, microservices clusters, continuous integration build jobs, and mid-tier database or caching layers.
